aboutGame.title: What is Trading Tycoon?
paragraphs: Trading Tycoon is a business trading simulator where you start with a small bankroll and build an empire one position at a time. You scout the market, buy assets low, hold through the noise, sell into strength, and reinvest the profit into upgrades that let you trade bigger.

Progress runs on capital and unlocks rather than reflexes. Every session adds new asset classes, faster trade tools, and deeper market information, so Trading Tycoon rewards planning, position sizing, and patience far more than lucky guesses.

modules.name: Trading Tycoon Beginner Guide
modules.description: Learn the core trading loop, the money rules that keep a small balance alive, and the exact first-session steps that turn a modest bankroll into steady growth.

highlights.detail: Tour the interface and find the price display, your holdings, and the order screen before spending anything.
Pick one asset type and learn its rhythm instead of spreading your attention across five markets.
Write two rules down first: your maximum position size and the point where you admit a trade failed.
Make three deliberately small trades to learn fees, spreads, and fill speed rather than to profit.
Log every planned entry, actual entry, exit, and the reason behind each trade.
Reinvest a slice of profit and keep a cash buffer so you can always buy the next dip.

modules.name: Trading Tycoon Trading Strategies
modules.description: Market strategies, entry and exit timing, spread reading, and the risk rules that keep your capital working in every session.

highlights.label: Scan
highlights.detail: Price-check three to five categories so you know today's spread before you spend anything.

highlights.label: Buy Low
highlights.detail: Enter below the recent average with a capped position size on every single trade.

highlights.label: Spreads
highlights.detail: Wide spreads mean buyers pay above cost — enter and exit quickly before the window closes.

highlights.label: Reserve
highlights.detail: Hold back about 20% of capital so every dip is an opportunity instead of a setback.

highlights.label: Rotate
highlights.detail: When a market gets crowded, rotate into a less contested niche with better margins.

highlights.label: Reinvest
highlights.detail: Compound profit into turnover so your capital works in every session, not just the lucky ones.

highlights.label: Storage
highlights.detail: Raises inventory capacity so you can hold more profitable stock per run — a top early buy.

highlights.label: Trade Speed
highlights.detail: Shortens the cooldown between entries so you complete more trades per session.

highlights.label: Market Info
highlights.detail: Unlocks deeper price history and forecasts for far fewer blind decisions.

highlights.label: Unlocks
highlights.detail: Opens higher-margin asset classes once your capital can support them.

highlights.label: Auto-Trade
highlights.detail: Adds passive income that keeps earning between your play sessions.

highlights.label: Cosmetics
highlights.detail: Appearance and prestige only — buy these once your economy is solved.

modules.name: Trading Tycoon Market Guide
modules.description: How supply, demand, liquidity, and volatility move prices, and how to read each market state before you commit capital.

highlights.label: Uptrend
highlights.detail: Higher highs and fast-clearing stock — buy small dips, hold, and sell into strength.

highlights.label: Downtrend
highlights.detail: Slow sales and undercutting sellers — stay in cash instead of catching a falling knife.

highlights.label: Sideways
highlights.detail: Prices bounce inside a range — buy near the low end and sell near the high end.

highlights.label: Volume
highlights.detail: Watch how much is trading, not just the price, to confirm whether a move is real.

highlights.label: Events
highlights.detail: Updates and restocks create short-lived spikes — sell into the first wave, not the last.

highlights.label: Scarcity
highlights.detail: Limited and seasonal stock commands premium prices whenever supply tightens.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common Trading Tycoon questions.

items.question: What is Trading Tycoon?
items.answer: Trading Tycoon is a business trading simulator where you start with a small bankroll, buy and sell assets, and reinvest profit into upgrades until a tiny venture becomes an empire.

items.question: How do I make money fast in Trading Tycoon?
items.answer: Start with cheap, fast-moving goods to build capital through volume, buy below the recent average, and keep a 20–30% cash reserve so you can act on every dip.

items.question: What should I upgrade first in Trading Tycoon?
items.answer: Prioritize inventory capacity, trade speed, and market information. These raise profit per session and reduce mistakes, and they pay for themselves faster than cosmetic items.

items.question: Are there codes in Trading Tycoon?
items.answer: Yes. Active Trading Tycoon codes grant free starting capital, boosts, and rewards. Redeem them the day they are posted, because most promotional codes expire within days.

items.question: What is the best strategy for beginners in Trading Tycoon?
items.answer: Pick one asset type, decide your maximum position size and exit point before you trade, and log the results. Consistency across fifty trades beats one lucky win.

items.question: Which platforms can I play Trading Tycoon on?
items.answer: Trading Tycoon is played through Roblox and is also available on Steam, so you can build your trading empire on the platform you already use.
